local_repairs: Codex colon and hash line/column ranges resolve to their start location
OSC 8 file URLs pass locations to the existing file opener and preserve escaped filename characters
Notification setup honors nonempty CODEX_HOME and recognizes quoted or legacy dispatcher paths
Notification installation repairs legacy quoting; uninstall preserves unrelated commands in mixed hook groups
Notification dispatcher uses the installed Command Line Tools Python executable when available to avoid the system launcher's Xcode license failure
Anchored Markdown links use the existing Raw editor for exact source positioning; ordinary Markdown retains the viewer preference
Markdown preview retains CodeSource, and Raw/editor transitions reuse the link's start location
Internal file-link jumps convert one-based source columns to zero-based buffer offsets
Editor and code-review LSP definition targets convert zero-based columns to the one-based file-opening contract
Notification permission feedback deduplicates and clears only permission errors after authorization recovery
Notification troubleshooting opens macOS notification settings; the help link opens Apple notification documentation
Native notification response delegate completes every action exactly once
